strategy.thesis: AI-specialized venture capital investing in seed and early-stage AI startups, with emphasis on generative AI and robotics; runs the KERNEL incubation community for AI researchers and engineers.

track_record.portfolio_count: 101 (62 in Fund I + 39 in Fund II as of 2023)

application.how_to_apply: Via DEEPCORE website / KERNEL community; engages with AI researchers and engineers building startups.

summary.en: DEEPCORE is one of Japan's flagship AI-specialized VCs. Founded in 2018 (with SoftBank Group as a key backer), it invests in seed and early-stage AI startups, focusing on generative AI and robotics. Its first fund (DEEPCORE TOKYO1) raised about ¥6B and backed 62 companies; its second fund (DEEPCORE TOKYO2) final-closed at ¥11.7B in May 2023. It also runs the KERNEL incubation community.
summary.local: ディープコアはAI領域に特化した日本を代表するVCの一つ。2018年設立(ソフトバンクグループが主要出資)で、シード・アーリーステージのAIスタートアップに投資し、生成AIやロボティクスに注力。1号ファンドは約60億円で62社に投資、2号ファンドは2023年5月に総額117億円でファイナルクローズ。インキュベーション施設「KERNEL」も運営する。

summary.en: Deep30 is a deep-learning-specialized seed VC fund (¥1B) founded in August 2018 by people connected to the University of Tokyo's Matsuo Yutaka Lab. It backs seed-stage AI startups with up to ¥50M per company, with UTEC and individuals as LPs. Notable bets include ACES and JDSC (which later IPO'd).
summary.local: Deep30は、東京大学・松尾豊研究室の関係者が運営する深層学習特化のシードVCファンド(10億円、2018年8月設立)。シード期のAIスタートアップに1社最大5000万円を投資し、LPはUTECや個人投資家。ACESやJDSC(後に上場)などに投資。

strategy.thesis: Seed-stage VC ('Empowering Mad Dreams') that launched what it describes as Japan's first fund specialized in generative-AI-native startups (ANOBAKA GAI 1号), investing at the pre-seed/seed phase, sometimes before a product exists.

program.eligibility: Generative-AI-native startups at the seed / pre-product stage

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the ANOBAKA website; accepts very early (pre-product) generative AI founders.

summary.en: ANOBAKA (formerly KLab Venture Partners; established Oct 2015) is a Tokyo seed VC that in April 2023 launched 'ANOBAKA GAI 1号', described as Japan's first fund specialized in generative-AI-native startups. It invests at the seed / pre-product stage, with CARTA HOLDINGS as anchor LP and a Microsoft for Startups partnership. Firm-wide it has backed 200+ companies. Specific GAI fund size and check size are undisclosed.
summary.local: ANOBAKA(旧KLab Venture Partners、2015年10月設立)は東京のシードVCで、2023年4月に国内初を謳う生成AIネイティブ特化ファンド「ANOBAKA GAI 1号」を設立。プロダクト前のシード段階から投資し、アンカーLPはCARTA HOLDINGS、Microsoft for Startupsと連携。累計200社超に投資。GAIファンドの規模・投資額は非公開。
